target_head_commit: HEAD (M1 Runtime Admission & Real Hardware Qualification)

findings.description: 針對 Volta CC 7.0 缺乏現代 Tensor Core / AWQ Marlin 核心的硬體限制，明確以 llama.cpp Q4_K_M 作為首選 Baseline，Pinned vLLM GPTQ 作為實驗加速路徑，Transformers FP16 作為數值對照基準，排序合理且職責分明。
DualGV100VRAMTracker 精確建模 35B/27B 模型在 TP=2 下的權重、KV Cache (32K context) 與 CUDA Overhead 記憶體開銷，成功區分 Q4_K_M (14.96GB/GPU，可行) 與 FP16 (38.60GB/GPU，OOM 攔截)。
Profiler 實現無外部依賴的連續 HTTP POST 請求測試，能完整記錄 TTFT、延遲與 est_decode_tps，並將退出門檻 (Exit Gate: 100 次連續請求且 0 corruption) 輸出為結構化 JSON。

non_claims: Passing offline contract tests does not substitute for actual physical multi-GPU stress tests under sustained thermal throttling conditions on bare-metal GV100 servers.
The advisory approval does not waive human architectural sign-off for live cluster deployment.
Calculated TPS estimations from synthetic payloads are indicative and subject to token length variance in real UVM benchmark workloads.
